hints.title: Bidirectional Round-Trip Cost
hints.text: Traveling from city u to city v, buying an apple, and returning costs appleCost[v] + (k + 1) * dist(u, v).

hints.title: Multi-Source Priority Initialization
hints.text: Initialize the best known cost for each city i to its local appleCost[i]. Treat all cities simultaneously as sources in a priority structure.

hints.title: Relaxation Across Roads
hints.text: When relaxing an edge between u and v of road cost w, candidate cost is dist[u] + (k + 1) * w. Propagate minimum values across the network.

hints.title: Multi-Source Dijkstra Implementation

complexity.notes: Single-pass multi-source priority queue Dijkstra achieves optimal network shortest paths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running n separate single-source Dijkstra algorithms takes O(n * (n + m) log n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n + m) memory for graph adjacency lists and priority queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models apple purchase as multi-source shortest path with scaled edge weights (k + 1) * w.
